events.title: Yen Rises After BoJ Sato's Hawkish Remarks
events.description: The Japanese yen strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday, following hawkish remarks by Bank of Japan (BoJ) board member Ayano Sato.

events.title: Bay Street Likely To Open On Weak Note
events.description: Higher oil and global bond yields suggest a negative start for Canadian stocks on Wednesday. The mood is likely to remain cautious amid a lack of fresh data and activity is most likely to be stock specific.

events.title: Yen Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday.

events.title: Euro Falls Amid Risk-Off Mood
events.description: The euro weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday, as European shares drifted lower with renewed Middle East tensions and France's deepening fiscal crisis keeping investors on edge.

events.title: German Industrial Production Rebounds
events.description: Germany's industrial production rebounded in August despite summer heatwave and geopolitical tensions, official data showed Wednesday. Industrial output expanded 2.0 percent on a monthly basis, in contrast to the 1.2 percent decrease in July, Destatis said. Production was expected to grow 0.5 percent.

events.title: Euro Falls Against Majors
events.description: The euro weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday.

events.title: FTSE 100 Slides On Oil, Bond Yields; Banks Lead Losses
events.description: The FTSE 100 fell 0.79% Wednesday as higher oil prices and bond yields pressured the index. Bank stocks declined sharply, with Standard Chartered dropping 3.6% and HSBC falling 3.2%. Pennon Group plummeted 17% after announcing a £550 million rights issue and 30% dividend cut.

events.title: CAC 40 Down Nearly 1% As Rising Oil Prices, Bond Yields Hurt Sentiment
events.description: French stocks shed ground on Wednesday as rising oil prices amid geopolitical tensions weighed on sentiment. Bond yields rose on concerns over political uncertainty in France, adding to the weak sentiment.

events.title: Indian Shares Fall After RBI Rate Hike
events.description: Indian shares fell notably on Wednesday after two days of gains amid diminished expectations for another Federal Reserve interest-rate hike in October.

events.title: DAX Slides As Oil Prices, Bond Yields Jump Higher
events.description: German equities declined Wednesday as oil prices and bond yields climbed higher, offsetting stronger-than-expected industrial production data. The DAX dropped 335.59 points to 25,113.60. Oil rose above $101 per barrel amid Persian Gulf tensions.

events.title: Gold Declines As Oil And Bond Yields Rise
events.description: Gold prices fell toward $4,100 an ounce on Wednesday as oil prices climbed and yields rebounded on fears Iran is stepping up attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: Oil Prices Rise Amid Houthi Attacks, US Storm Concerns
events.description: Oil prices were up nearly 1 percent on Wednesday as traders weighed supply risks following more attacks on vessels in the Persian Gulf region.

events.title: European Shares Slide On France's Fiscal Worries
events.description: European shares drifted lower on Wednesday, with renewed Middle East tensions and France's deepening fiscal crisis keeping investors on edge.
